Package com.macstab.chaos.jvm.startup

@NullMarked package com.macstab.chaos.jvm.startup
Plan reading and the agent's startup configuration.

Every type is non-null unless annotated @Nullable.

  • Class
    Description
    AgentArgs
    Immutable view of parsed agent arguments.
    AgentArgsParser
    Parses the raw -javaagent: argument string into an AgentArgs value object.
    AgentSettings
    The agent's settings, resolved once per start: each one is read from the agent argument, then the system property, then the environment variable(s).
    ChaosPlanMapper
    Jackson-based serialisation bridge between JSON and ChaosPlan.
    ConfigLoadException
    Thrown when a chaos plan cannot be loaded from any configured source during agent startup.
    DirectoryTrust
    The trust check of a directory the agent writes code into (bridgeDir): the directory must be neither world-writable without the sticky bit nor owned by another user than the JVM's (root excepted), no directory above it world-writable without the sticky bit or owned by another user, and no link on the configured path owned by another user.
    LogText
    Makes text safe to put into one log line: the agent's single sanitizer for paths, ids and error messages before they reach a logger or System.err.
    StartupConfigLoader
    Resolves and loads a ChaosPlan during JVM agent startup.
    StartupConfigLoader.LoadedPlan
    Result of successfully loading a chaos plan from a configuration source.
    StartupConfigLoader.PlanFile
    The file a configured plan path reads from, with what identifies its contents for change detection.
    StartupConfigLoader.PlanFileStamp
    What identifies a plan file's contents for change detection, taken without reading the file.
    TrustedSources
    The trust rule for the switches that enable fault injection or a management endpoint, for the Quarkus and Micronaut integrations (Spring decides with its own property sources).
    TrustedSources.Sourced
    A setting's raw value and the name of the config source it came from.
